title: Q3 — RDE + volumetric H2: separate Fe from HER (measure HER Tafel first)
purpose: Resolve the single dominant L0 unknown (the HER Tafel slope) by measuring the HER branch FIRST in the Fe-free bath, then fitting Fe with HER held fixed on the Fe-bath RDE, then confirming the split by volumetric charge-ledger closure.

closure.gas_assumption: ideal gas; calibrated on real-device saturated-vapour correction at L1

measurement_spec.title: Q3 — RDE + volumetric H2 (measure HER Tafel FIRST)
measurement_spec.resolves: #34 dominant uncertainty: her_tafel_V (the single coefficient that can flip the reference-cell pass verdict). Calibrates the cathode model (NEXT_STEPS #2.2/#3.1).

sequence.title: HER branch in the Fe-free supporting electrolyte
sequence.why: No Fe2+ ⇒ total cathodic current IS the HER branch. Unambiguous b_her and i0_her on the ACTUAL cathode surface.
sequence.bath: B0 master with FeSO4 omitted (same anion/pH/T/surface prep)
sequence.technique: RDE or static LSV (0.01-1 V/s), + EIS Rct near E_eq

sequence.title: Levich transport separation on the Fe bath
sequence.why: Plateau i_lim vs sqrt(omega) ⇒ D and the Nernst film thickness (delta) that calibrates diffusion_layer_1d.

sequence.title: Fe branch fit with HER HELD FIXED (from step 1)
sequence.why: Two free parameters (i0_fe, b_fe) vs a full polarization curve ⇒ non-degenerate Fe/HER separation.

sequence.title: Volumetric H2 confirmation at fixed j
sequence.why: Independent check: FE_HER = 2F·n_H2/Q vs deposit FE_Fe must close the charge ledger (≈1).
sequence.technique: gas burette / manometric cell + gravimetric deposit

gates: HER Tafel fit R2 >= 0.98 and slope in 0.06-0.20 V/dec (iron-group HER)
Levich plot R2 >= 0.995 on the plateau; recovered D within 25% of the Fe2+ literature anchor (7.2e-10 m^2/s at 25 C, Arrhenius-scaled)
Fe Tafel fit R2 >= 0.98, slope in 0.06-0.18 V/dec, positive i0
Charge ledger closure |FE_her + FE_fe - 1| <= 0.05 (tolerance to be tightened after metrology is qualified)
HER-branch residual (gas vs fitted branch) within the stated uncertainty budget

computes: Single-branch HER Tafel fit (b_her, i0_her) on the Fe-free bath — the #34 first measurement
Levich transport separation (D, Nernst delta) on the RDE Fe bath
Fe branch fit (i0_fe, b_fe) with the HER branch HELD FIXED (non-degenerate separation)
Volumetric H2 charge-ledger closure (FE_her gas vs FE_fe mass) and branch residual
Synthetic two-bath simulator + L0 self-test proving recoverability
Machine-readable measurement spec (what to measure, in what order, with gates)
does_not_compute: Surface-state drift / site-blocking corrections to HER (see models/surface_state.py)
Real wet-lab accuracy — L0 synthetic validation only until real run data exist
Anodic-branch fitting (module is cathodic-only by design)
Non-ideal gas / water-vapour correction for the gas burette (L1 task)
pH or temperature dependence of the fitted branches (fit at one condition)
calibration_required: One Fe-free run to fix HER on the actual cathode surface before any Fe-bath fit
One Fe-bath RDE Levich set to fix D/delta for diffusion_layer_1d
Volumetric H2 + deposit mass at at least 3 current densities for the closure gate
model_scope.key_uncertainty: The single dominant L0 unknown (b_her) is resolved by step 1. Residual levers are D (nu affects it ~nu^(1/4)) and the volumetric H2 gas correction; both are measured, not assumed.
model_scope.limitations: Screening module demonstrating the method on synthetic data. The procedure is validated to RECOVER known kinetics; no wet-lab dataset exists in this repository. It is NOT gate evidence.

status: L0 synthetic validation — NOT gate evidence
